title: Spritesheets Schema
description: Schema for spritesheets using enum names as keys

sprites.description: Map of sprite enum names to their metadata

spriteMetadata.description: Metadata for a single sprite type

zorder.description: Zorder value for rendering, one per sprite index

indices_per_frame.description: How many 'sprite_indices' entries make one animation frame. Each entry already selects a whole 'grid_size' area, so this is normally 1, including for multi-block sprites.

indices_per_sequence.description: How many 'sprite_indices' entries the animation loops over. The number of animation frames is this divided by 'indices_per_frame'. 1 = static sprite.

grid_size.description: width and height grid size for the multi-sprite

collision_mask.description: Which cells of the sprite collide, one boolean per 'grid_size' cell in row-major order (left to right, top to bottom). For NPCs these are the cells it stands on, used for collision and pathfinding clearance. Shortcut: a single entry (e.g. [true]) applies that value to every cell, whatever the 'grid_size'. Otherwise there must be at least one entry per cell. If omitted, every cell collides. All false is valid: the sprite does not collide (an NPC then logs a warning at spawn and cannot touch the player).

sprite_indices.description: Array of sprite indices in the texture
